description: Assembles everything needed to prepare for an interview on a saved GigHQ job application: the job and company context, the candidate's full profile, their Career Journal grouped by role (for STAR/CAR story material), which evidence best matches the role (to emphasize) and which competencies are weakly covered (to address or reframe), and a company briefing (Community Signal, H1B status, size). This read-only tool supplies context only — it does not generate interview questions, write STAR/CAR answers, or assess the candidate.

application_uuid.description: UUID of the saved GigHQ job application to prepare for.

name: prepare_for_interview
